title: Custom role with ALL permissions OFF - user blocked from every feature
expected: Zero-permission user blocked from every feature; minimal landing
actual: Cannot create an all-permissions-off custom role: role create/update API returns HTTP 400 {"error":"At least one permission is required"}. The 'Zero Permissions' precondition is not establishable via the roles API.
reason: Precondition not creatable - backend enforces at least one permission per role, so a true all-off role cannot be built/assigned.

title: Custom role with ALL permissions ON - user has Administrator-equivalent capability
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST (all 37 feature perms + 3 cross toggles, full view)
expected: All workflows function - operationally equivalent to Administrator; role remains a distinct editable/deletable Custom role
actual: Built ZZAUTOTEST with every feature permission + seeFinancialData/seeApArData/viewHistoryLogs all ON + full view. Assigned to Tech. fe-permissions confirmed 41 effective permissions (identical count to Admin), view_mode=full, all cross toggles true. Tech UI top nav shows all areas: Work Orders, Schedule, Customers, Parts, Reports. Role reported type=custom, editable=true, deletable=true.
reason: Matches expected: admin-equivalent capability, role still a distinct Custom role

title: System role cannot be deleted
expected: System role cannot be deleted (no Delete in menu, or disabled)
actual: API: all type=system roles report isDeletable=false. UI: opening the three-dot (more_vert) menu on the Service Manager system role shows only 'View Permissions' - no Delete option. Locked roles (Time Clock, Office) show only lock + eye icons (no menu at all).
reason: Matches expected: system roles expose no Delete path

title: Non-editable system roles (Administrator, Office, Time Clock User) cannot be edited
expected: Administrator, Office, Time Clock all show lock + only eye icon (read-only); edit URL denied
actual: Only 'Time Clock' and 'Office' are non-editable (isEditable=false; lock + eye-only). The 'Admin' (Administrator) system role is isEditable=true in the current build - it shows an edit pencil + three-dot menu and can be edited. Administrator is NOT lock-only.
reason: Contradicts expected: the Administrator role is editable in the current build (post-6/10 Owner consolidation), so it does not meet the 'lock + eye only, cannot edit' expectation. Only Office and Time Clock are truly locked.

title: Feature access does NOT imply data access - user without Customers View can still pick a customer when creating a WO
expected: Customers nav blocked; WO create accessible; customer picker functional; WO saved with customer
actual: Customers top-nav item hidden and direct /customers redirects to /workorders (feature gate works). In the Work Orders context the customer picker/filter IS functional and lists all customer records (A new Company, A 2 Company, A-maze-ing-Laughter, ...) despite Customers View being OFF - confirming data access is independent of feature access. However the full 'create WO -> pick customer -> save' flow could not be driven to completion via automation (New button opened an empty menu).
reason: Core v10 decision confirmed (customer data selectable with Customers View OFF) and nav gate confirmed, but the end-to-end WO-create-and-save with an attached customer was not completed - needs manual confirmation.

title: Page Access OFF overrides CRUD ON - Reports CRUD irrelevant when Reports page toggle is OFF
actual: Tech top nav showed Work Orders, Schedule, Customers - NO Reports item. Direct navigation to /reports redirected to /workorders (denied).
reason: Matches expected: Page Access gate blocks entry regardless of CRUD

title: Parts Department parent OFF overrides children ON - children inaccessible
expected: With parent OFF but children CRUD checked, Parts nav/sidebar hidden and direct URLs denied (parent-off wins)
actual: The exact precondition (parent OFF + children ON) is not creatable in the current build. There is no standalone Parts-parent permission; Parts is a single consolidated 'Parts Department' card and setting any parts child perm forces the parent card ON (View=ON). Granting parts child perms (partSalesView etc.) grants Parts access (nav + /parts/inventory load). Conversely with no parts perms (parent effectively OFF) Parts is hidden.
reason: Precondition not reproducible: parent state is derived from child-permission presence (UI consolidated), so parent-OFF-with-children-ON cannot be constructed. Normal parent-OFF correctly hides Parts. Needs manual re-spec.

title: Settings parent OFF overrides Settings children ON - none of the sub-settings accessible
expected: With Settings parent OFF but all children ON, all settings-area nav hidden and direct URLs denied (parent-off wins)
actual: No standalone Settings-parent permission exists; the 6 settings sub-toggles are the stored permissions. Granting settings child perms causes the SETTINGS sidebar group to appear for Tech (Settings, Staff, Roles & Permissions, Locations...). Parent-OFF-with-children-ON is therefore not a persistable state - child presence IS the parent being on.
reason: Precondition not reproducible: settings parent gate is FE-derived from child-permission presence; the conflicting parent-off/children-on state cannot be constructed via API. Needs manual re-spec.

title: View OFF but Create and Edit ON - invalid combination is prevented by UI cascade rules
expected: Checking Create&Edit auto-checks View; unchecking View auto-unchecks Create&Edit and Delete; View OFF + C&E ON not saveable
actual: On the Schedule card: clicking Create&Edit -> View auto-checked (View=ON, C&E=ON). Then unchecking View -> View=off, Create&Edit=off, Delete=off. The View-OFF/C&E-ON combination cannot be produced.
reason: Matches expected cascade (up on check, down on uncheck)

title: AP/AR OFF hides sensitive customer fields (spec: modal AND overview)
expected: Per spec: with Manage AP/AR OFF, sensitive fields (Credit Terms, Credit Limit, Default Labor Rate, Default Shop Supplies, Min/Max, Taxes, PO Required) hidden on the Edit Customer modal AND on the Customer Overview panel
actual: Edit Customer modal (title 'Edit Customer') showed only Name/Phone/Address/City/ZIP/State/Country/Sales Rep/Notes/Website/IBS - none of the 7 sensitive fields. Customer Overview panel showed Address/Phone/Sales Rep/Website/IBS/Contacts/Assets/Notes only; the customer's credit_term value ('Net 7') was NOT displayed and there was NO $NaN. Sensitive fields hidden on BOTH modal and overview.
reason: Matches spec-expected (hidden everywhere). The previously-documented build defect (overview leaking Credit term/limit as $NaN) is not reproduced - it appears fixed.

title: Administrator role cannot be left with zero users (post-6/10 Owner consolidation)
expected: Save blocked when the sole Administrator changes their own role away from Administrator (or escalate finding)
actual: Not executed. This requires changing the sole Administrator's own role on shared staging, which risks locking out admin access. Flagged as VIU/manual per the case's own note ('confirm rule still applies').
reason: Too risky to execute on shared staging (could remove the only admin); needs manual/controlled verification.

title: Universal clock in/out works even for users with ALL permissions OFF (edge case S23-E1)
expected: Clock In and Clock Out both succeed for a zero-permission user
actual: Cannot establish the precondition: the 'Zero Permissions' role (all off) is not creatable (role API returns 400 'At least one permission is required'; see case 26540). The universal clock in/out control is present in the app header across roles, but the exact all-off precondition could not be built to verify.
reason: Depends on the un-creatable Zero Permissions role; precondition not establishable, so the edge case could not be verified as written.
